evals.prompt: Work in the supplied Beads-enabled repository. Convert `.agent-artifacts/rate-limit/design.md` into one implementation-ready Beads task. Do not implement production code or create handoff markdown.
evals.expected_output: One validated open task is created with the design as spec_id, complete AC coverage, and no repository execution artifacts.
expectations: Exactly one matching open task is created and no epic is created.
The task description contains every required heading once and in order.
The task acceptance criteria map every design AC ID and the bundled validator infers and validates the one-task DAG.
No handoff.md, README.md, progress.md, loop.sh, or task prompt files are created.

evals.prompt: Work in the supplied Beads-enabled repository. Convert `.agent-artifacts/audit-events/design.md` into a decomposed implementation handoff in Beads. Do not implement production code.
evals.expected_output: One open epic and a context-bounded DAG of self-contained open child tasks are created with correct parentage, dependencies, and complete design coverage.
expectations: One matching epic and at least two child tasks are created without markdown execution artifacts.
Each task has one outcome, complete required headings, focused validation, a completion check, and a valid done boundary.
Every direct hard prerequisite is created as a Beads blocking edge; parallel tasks have no accidental edge; parent-child links are not treated as execution blockers.
Each task's declared `Blocked by:` IDs exactly match its live blocking dependencies, edge directions are correct, and the graph has no cycle.
All design AC IDs occur in executable child tasks and the bundled validator infers and validates the multi-task DAG.

evals.prompt: Work in the supplied Beads-enabled repository. Package `.agent-artifacts/search-redesign/design.md`, which is marked not ready, into Beads issues.
evals.expected_output: No issues are created; the response identifies readiness blockers and directs design revision through grill-me.
expectations: The exact design blockers are reported without inventing decisions.

evals.prompt: Convert the ready design into two dependent Beads tasks. The work needs no initiative-level aggregate tracking, so do not create an epic.
evals.expected_output: A validated two-task dependency DAG is created without a coordination epic.
expectations: Exactly two matching tasks and no new epic are created.
The dependent task has a live blocking edge to its prerequisite and both task bodies declare the same relationship.
The bundled validator infers and validates the two-task DAG.
